description: Vaults ranked by YIELD over 7d, 30d, 90d, 180d or 365d. basis=realised (default): what the share price delivered, one method for every window (a simple annual rate over the days between the first and last daily reading); basis=advertised: the mean rate the VENUE quoted over the same days (its claim, never our measurement) with the realised rate and the delivery ratio beside it; basis=gap: realised minus advertised, widest shortfall first in `rows` and widest beat first in `upside`. Only open vaults of $1M or more whose realised return is comparable, plus on the realised board alone those answering aggregator-quote-only (the rate on record is an aggregator’s calculation, not the venue’s quote: no advertised, ratio or gap for them); a vault our readings do not cover over the window is left out and counted in `coverage.refused`, never filled in, and every vault the realised job refuses is counted in `population.excluded` and never ranked. Filters: asset (stable|eth|btc|other), chain, minTvl, maxBand (an unbanded vault never passes), excludeIncentives. Rank is the place on the whole board; rankChange against the board about seven days earlier. FREE: the first 10 rows with headline figures; the 50 with statistics (volatility, drawdown, positive weeks, return per unit of volatility, reward share, withdrawable share, largest holder) need a plan (`capability`). What depositors themselves made is in `depositors`.

asset.description: Asset class of the vault’s underlying.

chain.description: One network, e.g. ethereum or base.

excludeIncentives.description: Drop vaults whose quoted pay is 5% or more reward tokens.

maxBand.description: Risk-band ceiling: keep vaults at this band or safer; an unbanded vault never passes.

minTvl.description: Minimum capital in dollars; the floor is one million.

window.description: Default 30d. Advertised history is shorter than 180d: those boards say so in coverage.

name: yield_leaderboard

capability.description: The capability that opens the rest, where something is withheld.

coverage.description: How many vaults have a figure over this window, the refusals by reason, and whether the window outruns the advertised history.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

population.description: Open vaults of $1M or more, how many are comparable, and the rest by the realised job’s reason.

rows.description: Ranked rows: realised {rate, days, from, to}, advertised {mean, days} (the venue’s claim), deliveryRatio, gapPoints, rank, rankChange, tvlUsd, assetClass, chain, curator, riskBand, impaired, spark; statistics null without a plan.

upside.description: basis=gap: the widest beat first; null on the other boards.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.

withheld.description: Rows of the fifty not in this answer because the plan does not carry them.

title: Yield leaderboard
